mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in 1 month does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between PAYEMS changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline and unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises simultaneously, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of HOUST declining and UNRATE rising does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the combined effect of these changes on 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, when the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 1 month and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%
failure_condition: If the joint condition of FEDFUNDS increasing > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the combined effect of these changes on 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
